Vienna has a tofu spot you should definitely know about. 🫵 You shouldn’t miss wienertofu if you love tofu dishes. The menu changes regularly, so there’s always something new to try. 🍽️ Their tofu is made from organic Austrian soybeans and you can really taste the difference. 🇦🇹 They have meat, veggie and vegan options. You’ll find dishes like tofu tartare, soups, curries and even tofu desserts! 🍮 So far, it’s definitely the best tofu we’ve tried in Austria. Make sure to save this spot or send it to a tofu lover. 🤭 📍 Karmelitermar
